lines.zh: 暖水里我摆开分叉的尾鳍。
lines.en: I spread my forked tail in the warm water.

lines.zh: 我和同伴并排贴着海草游。
lines.en: My companion and I swim abreast through the weeds.

lines.zh: 温水海洋的浪推着我向前。
lines.en: Warm current carries me over the shelf.

lines.zh: 我叉开尾鳍，拐过珊瑚角。
lines.en: I fork my tail and round the coral corner.

lines.zh: 每群只有我们两条，很安静。
lines.en: Only two of us in this school, and it is quiet.

lines.zh: 我游过一片暖得发亮的水。
lines.en: I cross a patch of water warm enough to glow.

lines.zh: 沙底的反光晃着我的眼。
lines.en: The sand below throws light into my eyes.

lines.zh: 我用尾叉拨开挡路的海草。
lines.en: My tail fork parts the weeds in my way.
The water is as warm as soup.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，继续往深处。
lines.en: I skirt the rock and keep heading deeper.

lines.zh: 我的鳍分开水流，像把叉子。
lines.en: My fins split the current like a fork.

lines.zh: 另一条鱼就在我左后方。
lines.en: The other fish stays just behind my left.
Surface light sinks into the warm shallows.
I cruise slowly along the shallow bank.

lines.zh: 我从两块珊瑚之间侧身穿过。
lines.en: I slip sideways between two corals.

lines.zh: 我在温水里慢慢转了个弯。
lines.en: I turn slowly in the warm water.

lines.zh: 我悬在暖水里，尾鳍轻摆。
lines.en: I hover in the warm water, tail barely moving.
Too warm to bother moving much.
I open my mouth and swallow water.
A school flickers past the coral far off.

lines.zh: 我把尾叉收拢，停在原地。
lines.en: I fold my tail fork and hold still.
The warm water tastes faintly of salt.
I wait for a small fish to drift close.
Weeds sway above my head.
I hear wind moving on the surface.

lines.zh: 沙面闪了一下，我懒得去看。
lines.en: Something glinted on the sand; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我转身，看着自己的尾影。
lines.en: I turn to watch my own tail shadow.
This warm patch is my territory.
I nudge the coral with my snout.

lines.zh: 呼吸的水流从我鳃边过去。
lines.en: Breathing water slips past my gills.

lines.zh: 岸上那人站着，我浮起来看。
lines.en: Someone stands on the bank; I float up.

lines.zh: 你在水边蹲下，我游近了。
lines.en: You crouch at the water's edge and I come closer.
Your shadow falls into the warm water.
I stare at you through the water.
Do you have any fish food?

lines.zh: 我绕着你影子圈出的水里打转。
lines.en: I swim loops inside the shadow you make.
Your footsteps carry into the water.
I rise to see who you are.
You put your face near the surface.
I tilt my tail and keep watching you.
Who hit me? The water is red.
My tail fork aches and twitches.
I burrow hard into the weeds.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我眼前全是花。
lines.en: One hit and my sight blurs.

lines.zh: 血丝在我身边一缕缕散开。
lines.en: Threads of blood unwind around me.
I twist to throw you off.
Stop; I cannot flee any further.
I am missing one scale.
I sink down against the sand.
It hurts; warm water cannot help.

lines.zh: 你手里的生鱼味飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of raw fish drifts over.
Fish food? My tail starts to beat.
That smell is fish, and it is fresh.
I drift closer, then stop again.

lines.zh: 你把饵一晃，我尾鳍跟着摆。
lines.en: You shake the bait; my tail answers.
A thread of blood reaches me.
I open my mouth and wait for it.

lines.zh: 别拿这点东西逗我，我饿。
lines.en: Do not dangle it; I am truly hungry.

lines.zh: 我绕着你手里的东西打转。
lines.en: I orbit whatever you hold out.

lines.zh: 再把饵放低一点点就好。
lines.en: Lower the bait one more inch, please.
You bump me and the water splashes everywhere.
My tail fork sweeps across your leg.
Stop shoving; I have nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，鳞片蹭得生疼。
lines.en: I hit you and my scales sting.
You step into the water and I bolt.
We collide and the water turns cloudy.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过，蹭了一下。
lines.en: I brush past you, close enough to touch.

lines.zh: 你横在水道中间，我过不去。
lines.en: Your legs block the channel I swim.
I slap my tail against your boot.
After the bump I hide in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我们两条绕着彼此转圈。
lines.en: The two of us circle each other.

lines.zh: 我用尾叉碰了碰她的鳍。
lines.en: I touch her fin with my tail fork.
Warm water is good for raising fry.

lines.zh: 她摆尾往前，我跟在后头。
lines.en: She beats ahead; I keep behind her.
Side by side, our tails beat together.
This school will only ever hold us two.
She waits for me by the weeds.
I press my head gently against her.
The warm ocean is our nest.
One day there will be small tail forks.
The bucket dips and I am scooped up.
The slick walls have bumped me three times.
Away from warm water I will get cold.
The rocking makes my tail go numb.
Which sea are you taking me to?
I turn one circle in the bucket.

lines.zh: 水不够，我的鳃张得更大。
lines.en: Too little water; my gills open wide.
Do not leave me drying on the bank.
Your footsteps come from outside the bucket.
I press my tail fork to the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里动了一下。
lines.en: Something moved in the water.

lines.zh: 我盯着那片晃动的海草。
lines.en: I fix on the swaying patch of weeds.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游进了我的视野。
lines.en: A small fish swam into my view.
I turn toward that ripple.
Is it food, or something else?
My tail tightens; I am ready to approach.

lines.zh: 那团影子不像我认得的鱼。
lines.en: That shape is no fish I know.
I drift slowly toward the sound.
There is an unfamiliar taste in the water.
I stop and look before moving.
I swim around it, hunting a gap.
It moves and I follow one step.

lines.zh: 我把尾叉对准它的方向。
lines.en: I aim my tail fork at its direction.
Silt hides what it looks like.
If I wait longer it will escape.
I press my belly to the seabed.
It has hidden behind the coral.
I hold one body length away.
My gills open and close, fast.
Now; I beat my tail and charge.
I ram its side with my snout.
My tail fork sweeps and barely connects.
I bite, but my teeth are blunt.
The hit rolls it over once.
I strike and retreat at once.
There was no strength in that.
My shove pushes it back two lengths.
My tail fin slaps its side.
After biting, my mouth is full of water.
I flick my tail for one more hit.
Warm water is the first thing I feel.
The sea is warm; I like it.
Another one of my kind is beside me.
I test the new fork of my tail.
Coral glows in the distance.

lines.zh: 这是温水海洋，我到家了。
lines.en: This is the warm ocean; I am home.
I lift off the sandy bottom.
The first mouthful of seawater is salty.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块礁石游了一圈。
lines.en: I swim one circle around a rock.
I will settle in this warm water.
The water boils; I flee deeper.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下来，摔懵了。
lines.en: I fell from the surface and landed stunned.

lines.zh: 泡在水里却吸不进一口。
lines.en: In the water, I still cannot draw air.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，水把我推开了。
lines.en: A blast shoves the water into me.
Something sharp went into my fin.
A strange force crawls under my scales.
So hungry I bite the sand.
White light strikes the sea and I go numb.
No water here, and no light.
